templates.title: Hexis
templates.name: hexis
templates.description: Self-hosted knowledge base for AI agents and people: skills, tools and processes in a git-backed workspace, served to any agent over MCP, with change requests gating every edit.
templates.note: Fill in the four required values below, then deploy. Sign in with the admin email and password; the setup screen collects the knowledge-base repository on first sign-in. Generate the two secrets with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('base64'))". Details: https://github.com/Bevel-Software/Hexis

env.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
env.label: Admin email
env.description: The deployment owner — always an admin, whatever the sign-in method.

env.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
env.label: Admin password
env.description: Bootstrap sign-in password for the admin email.

env.name: JWT_SECRET
env.label: JWT secret
env.description: Signs login sessions. Any long random string.

env.name: SECRETS_ENC_KEY
env.label: Secrets encryption key
env.description: 32-byte key (base64 or hex) encrypting stored secrets and tokens.

env.name: HEXIS_VERSION
env.label: Version
env.description: Release to run (the published image tag). Pin it; bump deliberately to upgrade.
